query_language: ASCII query characters only; existing Unicode document word tokenization, ASCII-only stemming

stemming.suffix_rule: Delete the first matching suffix only when the remaining prefix has at least the listed length. Do not strip s from a word ending ss.
stemming.after_ing: If the remaining final two letters are identical and belong to bdfgmnprt, delete the last letter.
stemming.then_derivation: Delete ion or ment if the remaining prefix length is at least4; first match only.
stemming.then_terminal: Delete terminal e or y if the remaining current word length>=5.
stemming.required_invariant: Every stem is a nonempty prefix of its original token. Match query stems against original candidate words. Document stems are used only for exact-morphology/phrase bonuses.

eligibility: At least min(2,content_term_count) distinct content terms match and at least one matched term has best field weight>=5; no-content query returns no matches, not browse.
candidate_predicate: At least one original candidate word starts with any query stem, after existing hard filters. Apply the same512 cap before scoring on every engine. Overflow is query_too_broad; never truncate silently.
